diffs.diff: distance_cm: datasheet reading gives 0.017241 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: The JSN-SR04T-2.0 datasheet states: "through the IO port ECHO output a high level, high time is the duration of ultrasound from the launch to the return time. Test distance = (high time * speed of sound (340M / s)) / 2". That is 0.0170 cm per us of ECHO high time (58.82 us per cm). The model has this conversion, as sim.echo.usPerCm = 58.82 and US_PER_CM = 58.82 in the driver (distance_cm = t / 58.82). The publish gate only reads measure/responses/analog conversions, not the ultrasonic echo block, so it reports 'none'. The second reading's 0.017241 = 1/58 us per cm is the common Arduino rule of thumb (about 343-345 m/s), not the datasheet's 340 m/s. It differs from the model by 1.4%, which is within the gate's 2% tolerance. The model matches the datasheet, so nothing needs to change.
